e_hi: कई ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में पढ़ने की आदत की कमी मुख्य कारण है।
e_en: A lack of reading habit in many rural areas is the main cause.

q_hi: एक शिक्षक ने कक्षा में छात्रों को ‘कथन, व्याख्या और निष्कर्ष’ के बीच अंतर सिखाया। यदि एक छात्र ‘कथन’ को गलत समझता है, तो उसे क्या करना चाहिए?
q_en: A teacher taught students the difference between statement, explanation, and conclusion. If a student misunderstands a statement, what should he do?
o_hi: उसे नोट्स को अनदेखा करना चाहिए
उसे शिक्षक को दोष देना चाहिए
e_hi: गलतफहमी को दूर करने के लिए प्रश्न पूछना सबसे अच्छा उपाय है।
e_en: Asking a question is the best way to clear a misunderstanding.

q_hi: एक शोध पत्र में लिखा है कि ‘उच्च रक्तचाप वाले रोगियों में एंटीहाइपरटेंसिव दवाओं का समय पर सेवन जीवन प्रत्याशा बढ़ाता है’। इस कथन से क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है?
q_en: A research paper states that ‘timely intake of antihypertensive drugs in patients with high blood pressure increases life expectancy’. What can be inferred?
o_hi: दवाओं का सेवन अनिवार्य नहीं है
समय पर दवा लेने से मृत्यु दर कम होती है
उच्च रक्तचाप का कोई इलाज नहीं है
o_en: Taking drugs on time reduces mortality
e_hi: कथन से पता चलता है कि समय पर दवा लेने से मृत्यु दर कम होती है।
e_en: The statement indicates that timely drug intake reduces mortality.

q_hi: एक कंपनी ने अपनी नई नीतियों के तहत ‘स्मार्ट वर्किंग’ को अपनाया है। इस नीति के तहत कर्मचारियों को क्या लाभ मिलता है?
q_en: A company adopted a ‘Smart Working’ policy. What benefit does this policy provide to employees?
o_hi: कर्मचारी घर से काम कर सकते हैं
कर्मचारी को अतिरिक्त छुट्टियाँ मिलती हैं
कर्मचारी को उच्च वेतन मिलता है
कर्मचारी को अधिक ओवरटाइम काम करना पड़ता है
e_hi: स्मार्ट वर्किंग से कर्मचारियों को घर से काम करने की सुविधा मिलती है।
e_en: Smart Working allows employees to work from home.

q_hi: किसी उपन्यास में नायक ने अपने गृहनगर को छोड़कर शहर में नया जीवन शुरू किया। इस निर्णय के पीछे मुख्य प्रेरणा क्या थी?
q_en: In a novel, the protagonist left his hometown to start a new life in the city. What was the main motivation behind this decision?
e_hi: पाठ में उल्लेख है कि बेहतर शिक्षा प्राप्त करने के लिए वह शहर गया।
e_en: The text indicates he went to the city to obtain better education.

q_hi: एक साक्षात्कार में एक उम्मीदवार ने कहा कि वह ‘कठिन समय में भी सकारात्मक रहना’ पसंद करता है। इस कथन से उसके व्यक्तित्व के बारे में क्या अनुमान लगाया जा सकता है?
q_en: In an interview, a candidate said he likes to ‘stay positive even in tough times’. What can be inferred about his personality?
o_hi: उसे चुनौतियों से डर लगता है
वह दबाव में भी शांत रहता है
उसे सफलता की परवाह नहीं है
e_hi: कठिन समय में सकारात्मक रहने से पता चलता है कि वह दबाव में भी शांत रहता है।
e_en: Staying positive in tough times suggests he remains calm under pressure.

q_hi: एक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, ‘वर्ष 2023 में ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में इंटरनेट की पहुँच 70% तक बढ़ी है’। इस आँकड़े से क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है?
q_en: According to a report, ‘Internet penetration in rural areas reached 70% in 2023’. What can be inferred?
o_hi: सभी ग्रामीणों के पास इंटरनेट है
ग्रामीणों की डिजिटल पहुँच बढ़ रही है
इंटरनेट का उपयोग घट रहा है
e_hi: आँकड़े से यह स्पष्ट है कि ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में डिजिटल पहुँच बढ़ रही है।
e_en: The statistic indicates that digital access is increasing in rural areas.

q_hi: कक्षा A में 30 छात्र हैं। कक्षा B में कक्षा A से 15 कम छात्र हैं। कक्षा B में कितने छात्र हैं?
q_en: Class A has 30 students. Class B has 15 fewer students than Class A. How many students are in Class B?
e_en: Students in Class B = 30 - 15 = 15.

q_hi: पशु जगत को आवास के आधार पर तीन प्रमुख समूहों में बाँटा जाता है। स्थलीय पशु धरती पर रहते हैं, जलीय पशु पानी में, और जलीय-स्थलीय पशु दोनों में रहते हैं।\n\nकौन सा समूह उस पशु को दर्शाता है जो दोनों भूमि और पानी में रह सकता है?
q_en: Animals are divided into three main groups based on habitat: terrestrial animals live on land, aquatic animals live in water, and amphibious animals can live in both. Which group best describes an animal that can live both on land and in water?
e_hi: जलीय-स्थलीय पशु दोनों आवासों में रह सकते हैं, जैसे मेंढक।
e_en: Amphibious animals can live in both habitats, such as frogs.

q_hi: कवियों द्वारा अक्सर रूपक भाषा का प्रयोग किया जाता है। रूपक दो असमान चीजों की तुलना बिना 'जैसे' या 'समान' शब्द के करता है। उपमा 'जैसे' या 'समान' शब्द के साथ तुलना करती है। व्यक्तित्वकरण (पर्सनिफिकेशन) गैर-मानव वस्तुओं को मानवीय गुण देता है।\n\nवाक्य "हवा पेड़ों से फुसफुसा रही थी" में कौन सा साहित्यिक उपकरण प्रयोग हुआ है?
q_en: Poets often use figurative language. A metaphor compares two unlike things without 'like' or 'as'. A simile uses 'like' or 'as'. Personification gives human traits to non-human objects. In the sentence "The wind whispered through the trees," which device is used?
e_hi: इस वाक्य में हवा को बोलने वाला व्यक्ति बना दिया गया है, जो व्यक्तित्वकरण है।
e_en: The sentence gives the wind human-like ability to whisper, which is personification.

q_hi: भोजन को तीन मुख्य श्रेणियों में बाँटा जा सकता है: कार्बोहाइड्रेट, प्रोटीन, और वसा।\n\nनिम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रोटीन का स्रोत है?
q_en: Food can be classified into three main categories: carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. Which of the following is a source of protein?
e_hi: चिकन प्रोटीन का अच्छा स्रोत है।
e_en: Chicken is a good source of protein.

q_hi: प्रोग्रामिंग में डेटा को प्रिमिटिव और नॉन-प्रिमिटिव प्रकारों में विभाजित किया जाता है। प्रिमिटिव प्रकारों में पूर्णांक, फ्लोट, बूलियन, और कैरेक्टर शामिल हैं।\n\nनिम्नलिखित में से कौन सा नॉन-प्रिमिटिव डेटा टाइप है?
q_en: In programming, data is divided into primitive and non-primitive types. Primitive types include integers, floats, booleans, and characters. Which of the following is a non-primitive data type?
e_hi: स्ट्रिंग एक ऑब्जेक्ट है और प्रिमिटिव नहीं है।
e_en: String is an object and not a primitive type.

q_hi: अरस्तू ने तीन रेटोरिकल अपील पहचाने: एथोस, पाथोस, और लॉगोस। एथोस विश्वसनीयता पर बल देता है, पाथोस भावनाओं पर, और लॉगोस तर्क पर।\n\nकिस अपील का प्रयोग तब किया जाता है जब वक्ता एक आँकड़ा प्रस्तुत करता है ताकि दावे का समर्थन हो सके?
q_en: Aristotle identified three rhetorical appeals: ethos, pathos, and logos. Ethos appeals to credibility, pathos to emotion, and logos to logic. Which appeal is used when a speaker cites a statistic to support a claim?
e_hi: लोगोस तर्क आधारित अपील है, आँकड़ों से समर्थन मिलता है।
e_en: Logos is the logical appeal that uses statistics to support a claim.

q_hi: कारों को ऊर्जा स्रोत के आधार पर वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है: गैसोलीन, डीज़ल, इलेक्ट्रिक, या हाइड्रोजन।\n\nकौन सा वाहन विद्युत ऊर्जा से चलता है?
q_en: Cars can be categorized by power source: gasoline, diesel, electric, or hydrogen. Which of the following vehicles is powered by electricity?
e_hi: इलेक्ट्रिक साइकिल केवल विद्युत से चलती है।
e_en: An electric bicycle runs solely on electricity.

q_hi: उपन्यासों को शैलियों में बाँटा जा सकता है: मिस्ट्री, रोमांस, साइंस फिक्शन, और हॉरर।\n\nकौन सी शैली भविष्य की तकनीक और कल्पित अवधारणाओं पर केंद्रित है?
q_en: Novels can be categorized into genres such as mystery, romance, science fiction, and horror. Which genre focuses on futuristic technology and speculative concepts?
e_hi: साइंस फिक्शन भविष्य की तकनीक पर आधारित है।
e_en: Science fiction is based on futuristic technology and speculative ideas.

q_hi: कानूनी शब्दावली में दस्तावेज़ों को प्राथमिक और द्वितीयक स्रोतों में विभाजित किया जाता है। प्राथमिक स्रोतों में विधान, केस लॉ, और नियम शामिल हैं।\n\nनिम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कानून का प्राथमिक स्रोत है?
q_en: In legal terminology, documents are classified as primary and secondary sources. Primary sources include statutes, case law, and regulations. Which of the following is a primary source of law?
e_hi: विधान कानून का प्राथमिक स्रोत है।
e_en: A statute is a primary source of law.

q_hi: मनोवैज्ञानिक विकारों को वर्गीकृत किया जाता है: चिंता विकार, मूड विकार, मनोविकृति विकार, और व्यक्तित्व विकार।\n\nकौन सा विकार मूड विकारों के अंतर्गत आता है?
q_en: Psychological disorders are categorized into anxiety disorders, mood disorders, psychotic disorders, and personality disorders. Which disorder falls under mood disorders?
e_hi: मुख्य अवसादग्रस्तता मूड विकार है।
e_en: Major depressive disorder is a mood disorder.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा सर्वनाम है?
q_en: Which of the following words is a pronoun?
e_hi: "She" एक सर्वनाम है क्योंकि यह किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को दर्शाता है।
e_en: "She" is a pronoun because it refers to a person or entity.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द क्रिया विशेषण (adverb) है?
q_en: Which of the following words is an adverb?
e_hi: "Quickly" क्रिया विशेषण है क्योंकि यह क्रिया को संशोधित करता है।
e_en: "Quickly" is an adverb because it modifies a verb.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में से कौन सा संयुक्त वाक्य (compound sentence) है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is a compound sentence?
o_hi: She likes tea, and he likes coffee.
She likes tea because he likes coffee.
She likes tea; he likes coffee.
She likes drinking tea in the morning.
o_en: She likes tea, and he likes coffee.
She likes tea because he likes coffee.
She likes tea; he likes coffee.
She likes drinking tea in the morning.
e_hi: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction such as 'and'. The first sentence does this; the others use a subordinating conjunction, a semicolon, and a single simple clause respectively.
e_en: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction such as 'and'. The first sentence does this; the others use a subordinating conjunction, a semicolon, and a single simple clause respectively.

q_hi: "neither…nor" किस प्रकार का संयोजक है?
q_en: "neither…nor" is a type of which conjunction?
e_hi: "neither…nor" एक विभक्ति संयोजक है जो दो विकल्पों को अस्वीकार करता है।
e_en: "neither…nor" is a disjunctive conjunction that negates two alternatives.

q_hi: "inadequately" किस प्रकार का शब्द है?
q_en: "inadequately" is a type of which part of speech?
e_hi: "inadequately" क्रिया विशेषण है क्योंकि यह क्रिया को संशोधित करता है।
e_en: "inadequately" is an adverb as it modifies a verb.

q_hi: कौन सा उपवाक्य एक जटिल वाक्य (complex sentence) है?
q_en: Which of the following clauses is a complex sentence?
o_hi: Although it was raining, they went out.
She likes tea and he likes coffee.
She likes tea; he likes coffee.
They went out and enjoyed the rain.
o_en: Although it was raining, they went out.
She likes tea and he likes coffee.
She likes tea; he likes coffee.
They went out and enjoyed the rain.
e_hi: A complex sentence has one independent and one dependent clause. 'Although it was raining, they went out.' fits this; the others are compound or simple sentences.
e_en: A complex sentence has one independent and one dependent clause. 'Although it was raining, they went out.' fits this; the others are compound or simple sentences.

q_hi: "beautifully" शब्द किस श्रेणी में आता है जब इसका प्रयोग "She sings beautifully." में किया जाए?
q_en: In the sentence "She sings beautifully.", the word "beautifully" belongs to which part of speech?
e_hi: यह क्रिया विशेषण है क्योंकि यह क्रिया "sings" को संशोधित करता है।
e_en: It is an adverb because it modifies the verb "sings."

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द एक विस्मयादिबोधक (interjection) है?
q_en: Which of the following words is an interjection?
e_hi: "Wow" एक विस्मयादिबोधक है जो भाव व्यक्त करता है।
e_en: "Wow" is an interjection expressing emotion.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य एक जटिल-सम्बद्ध वाक्य (complex‑compound sentence) है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is a complex‑compound sentence?
o_hi: I will go to the market, and I will buy milk.
I will go to the market because I need milk, and I will also visit my friend.
I will go to the market, but I will not buy milk.
I will go to the market, and I will buy milk, and I will read a book.
o_en: I will go to the market, and I will buy milk.
I will go to the market because I need milk, and I will also visit my friend.
I will go to the market, but I will not buy milk.
I will go to the market, and I will buy milk, and I will read a book.
e_hi: दूसरा वाक्य एक जटिल-सम्बद्ध वाक्य है क्योंकि इसमें एक अवलंबी उपवाक्य और दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य हैं।
e_en: The second sentence is complex‑compound because it has one dependent clause and two independent clauses.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द "quick" का क्रिया विशेषण रूप है?
q_en: Which of the following is the adverbial form of "quick"?
e_hi: "Quickly" "quick" का क्रिया विशेषण रूप है।
e_en: "Quickly" is the adverbial form of "quick."

q_hi: वाक्य में रिक्त स्थान पर सही शब्द चुनें: "She has been studying for two hours, but she is still not ___."
q_en: Choose the correct word to fill the blank: "She has been studying for two hours, but she is still not ___."
e_hi: ‘Finished’ यहाँ वर्तमान परिपूर्ण (present perfect) काल के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है, इसलिए यह सही उत्तर है।
e_en: ‘Finished’ is the correct form to match the present perfect tense used earlier in the sentence.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से सही है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
o_hi: She have gone to the market.
They are going to the market.
o_en: She have gone to the market.
They are going to the market.
e_hi: ‘They are going to the market’ में ‘are’ सही विषय-क्रिया संयोजन है।
e_en: ‘They are going to the market’ uses the correct subject-verb agreement.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: "Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the changes."
q_en: Select the correct sentence: "Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the changes."
e_hi: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject (the rule of proximity). The nearer subject here is 'the employees' (plural), so 'were' is correct.
e_en: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject (the rule of proximity). The nearer subject here is 'the employees' (plural), so 'were' is correct.

q_hi: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: "If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train."
q_en: Choose the correct verb form: "If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train."
e_hi: यह तीसरा शर्त वाक्य (third conditional) है, इसलिए ‘had arrived’ सही है।
e_en: This is a third conditional sentence, so ‘had arrived’ is the correct form.

q_hi: Which sentence is the correct passive form of the active sentence: 'The chef baked the cake.'?
q_en: Which sentence is the correct passive form of the active sentence: 'The chef baked the cake.'?
o_hi: The cake was baked by the chef.
The cake baked by the chef.
The cake is baked by the chef.
o_en: The cake was baked by the chef.
The cake baked by the chef.
The cake is baked by the chef.
e_hi: The passive voice moves the object to the subject position and uses 'be' + past participle: 'The cake was baked by the chef.'
e_en: The passive voice moves the object to the subject position and uses 'be' + past participle: 'The cake was baked by the chef.'

q_hi: वाक्य में सही सर्वनाम चुनें: "___ will be responsible for the project."
q_en: Choose the correct pronoun: "___ will be responsible for the project."
e_hi: सही विकल्प ‘They’ है क्योंकि यह विषय सर्वनाम है।
e_en: The correct option is ‘They’ as it is a subject pronoun.

q_hi: सही शब्द अनुक्रम चुनें: "She ___ to the office every day."
q_en: Select the correct word order: "She ___ to the office every day."
e_hi: ‘Goes’ वर्तमान सरल काल में सही है।
e_en: ‘Goes’ is correct in simple present tense.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही रूप से ‘because’ का उपयोग करता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses ‘because’?
o_hi: I will not go because I am tired.
I will not go because I am tireds.
Because I am tired, I will not go because.
I will not go because I am tired, because.
o_en: I will not go because I am tired.
I will not go because I am tireds.
Because I am tired, I will not go because.
I will not go because I am tired, because.
e_hi: पहला वाक्य ‘because’ के सही प्रयोग को दर्शाता है।
e_en: The first sentence correctly uses ‘because’.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: "There is many reasons for this decision."
q_en: Choose the grammatically correct sentence: "There is many reasons for this decision."
o_hi: There is many reasons for this decision.
There are many reasons for this decision.
There were many reasons for this decision.
There was many reasons for this decision.
o_en: There is many reasons for this decision.
There are many reasons for this decision.
There were many reasons for this decision.
There was many reasons for this decision.
e_hi: ‘There are many reasons’ सही विषय-क्रिया संयोजन है।
e_en: ‘There are many reasons’ has correct subject-verb agreement.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही रूप से ‘past perfect’ का उपयोग करता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect tense?
o_hi: She had finished the work before the deadline.
She has finished the work before the deadline.
She will have finished the work before the deadline.
She had finish the work before the deadline.
o_en: She had finished the work before the deadline.
She has finished the work before the deadline.
She will have finished the work before the deadline.
She had finish the work before the deadline.
e_hi: ‘Had finished’ past perfect को दर्शाता है।
e_en: ‘Had finished’ represents the past perfect tense.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही रूप से ‘modal verb’ का प्रयोग करता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses a modal verb?
e_hi: ‘Should study’ सही मोडल वर्ब संरचना है।
e_en: ‘Should study’ is the correct modal verb construction.

q_hi: सही शब्द चुनें: "He has been working here ___ 2005."
q_en: Choose the correct word: "He has been working here ___ 2005."
e_hi: ‘Since’ का प्रयोग किसी समय बिंदु के लिए किया जाता है।
e_en: ‘Since’ is used for a specific point in time.

q_hi: Which word correctly connects cause and effect in the sentence: 'He arrived late, ___ he missed his train.'
q_en: Which word correctly connects cause and effect in the sentence: 'He arrived late, ___ he missed his train.'
e_hi: 'Because' correctly introduces the reason ('he missed his train') for the result ('he arrived late').
e_en: 'Because' correctly introduces the reason ('he missed his train') for the result ('he arrived late').

q_hi: वाक्य को पूरा करने के लिये कौन सा शब्द सही है? 'वह कड़ी मेहनत करता है, ___ वह सफल हो जाता है।'
q_en: Which word correctly completes: 'He works hard, ___ he becomes successful.'
e_hi: 'इसलिए' का अर्थ प्रभाव दर्शाता है।
e_en: 'therefore' indicates the effect.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य 'so that' का सही प्रयोग दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses 'so that'?
o_hi: मैंने उसे फोन किया, ताकि वह समय पर पहुँच सके।
मैंने उसे फोन किया, क्योंकि वह समय पर पहुँच सके।
मैंने उसे फोन किया, और वह समय पर पहुँच सके।
मैंने उसे फोन किया, तब वह समय पर पहुँच सके।
o_en: I called him so that he could arrive on time.
I called him because he could arrive on time.
I called him and he could arrive on time.
I called him then he could arrive on time.
e_hi: 'ताकि' या 'so that' का प्रयोग उद्देश्य दर्शाने के लिये होता है।
e_en: 'so that' expresses purpose.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य 'since' का प्रयोग समय बताने के लिये करता है?
q_en: Which sentence uses 'since' to indicate time rather than cause?
o_hi: Since I was tired, I went to bed early.
Since the rain started, the game was postponed.
o_en: Since I was tired, I went to bed early.
Since the rain started, the game was postponed.
e_hi: 'Since 1990' में 'since' का प्रयोग समय के लिये किया गया है।
e_en: 'Since 1990' uses 'since' to indicate time.

q_hi: Which sentence correctly expresses cause and effect using 'because'?
q_en: Which sentence correctly expresses cause and effect using 'because'?
o_hi: He fell asleep early because he was tired.
He was tired, because he fell asleep early.
Because he fell asleep early, he was tired.
He was tired, and he fell asleep early because.
o_en: He fell asleep early because he was tired.
He was tired, because he fell asleep early.
Because he fell asleep early, he was tired.
He was tired, and he fell asleep early because.
e_hi: 'He fell asleep early because he was tired.' correctly places the reason ('he was tired') after 'because', with the result stated first.
e_en: 'He fell asleep early because he was tired.' correctly places the reason ('he was tired') after 'because', with the result stated first.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य 'as a result' का सही प्रयोग दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses 'as a result' to indicate effect?
o_hi: The company lost revenue as a result of high taxes.
As a result, the company lost revenue due to high taxes.
High taxes caused the company to lose revenue as a result.
As a result high taxes caused the company to lose revenue.
o_en: The company lost revenue as a result of high taxes.
As a result, the company lost revenue due to high taxes.
High taxes caused the company to lose revenue as a result.
As a result high taxes caused the company to lose revenue.
e_hi: तीसरे वाक्य में कारण के बाद प्रभाव को सही ढंग से दर्शाया गया है।
e_en: The third sentence correctly shows the effect after the cause.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य 'although' का सही प्रयोग दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses 'although' to express contrast?
o_hi: Although it was raining, the match continued.
It was raining, although the match continued.
Although the match continued, it was raining.
The match continued although it was raining.
o_en: Although it was raining, the match continued.
It was raining, although the match continued.
Although the match continued, it was raining.
The match continued although it was raining.
e_hi: 'although' के बाद मुख्य वाक्य आता है।
e_en: After 'although' comes the main clause.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य में कौन सा शब्द कारण को दर्शाता है? 'She left early because she was sick.'
q_en: In the sentence 'She left early because she was sick.', which word indicates cause?
e_hi: 'क्योंकि' कारण को दर्शाता है।
e_en: 'because' indicates the cause.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य सही कारण-परिणाम श्रृंखला दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly shows a chain of cause and effect?
o_hi: If it rains, the ground gets wet; therefore, plants grow.
If plants grow, the ground gets wet; therefore, it rains.
Therefore, it rains; if the ground gets wet, plants grow.
It rains, therefore, if the ground gets wet, plants grow.
o_en: If it rains, the ground gets wet; therefore, plants grow.
If plants grow, the ground gets wet; therefore, it rains.
Therefore, it rains; if the ground gets wet, plants grow.
It rains, therefore, if the ground gets wet, plants grow.
e_hi: पहला वाक्य कारण-परिणाम की सही श्रृंखला दिखाता है।
e_en: The first sentence shows a correct cause-effect chain.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य में क्रिया का सही रूप कौन सा है? 'She ___ to the market every morning.'
q_en: Which is the correct form of the verb in the sentence: 'She ___ to the market every morning.'
e_hi: वाक्य का विषय 'She' है, अतः क्रिया का तीसरा पुरुष एकवचन रूप 'goes' होना चाहिए।
e_en: The subject is 'She', a third‑person singular, so the verb must be 'goes'.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द 'She is good ___ mathematics' में उपयुक्त है?
q_en: Which preposition best fits in 'She is good ___ mathematics'?
e_hi: गणित में दक्षता को दर्शाने के लिये 'good at' का प्रयोग होता है।
e_en: The idiomatic phrase is 'good at' to express proficiency in mathematics.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को निष्क्रिय वाच्य में परिवर्तित करें: 'The committee will approve the proposal tomorrow.'
q_en: Convert the following sentence to passive voice: 'The committee will approve the proposal tomorrow.'
o_hi: The proposal will be approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal was approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal is approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal will be approving by the committee tomorrow.
o_en: The proposal will be approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal was approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal is approved by the committee tomorrow.
The proposal will be approving by the committee tomorrow.
e_hi: भविष्य काल को निष्क्रिय में बदलने पर 'will be approved' आता है।
e_en: In passive voice the future tense becomes 'will be approved'.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: '___ did you see at the station?'
q_en: Choose the correct sentence: '___ did you see at the station?'
e_hi: यह प्रश्न क्रिया के कर्म के लिये है, अतः 'whom' सही है।
e_en: The question asks for the object of the verb, so 'whom' is correct.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: 'There ___ many reasons for this decision.'
q_en: Choose the correct sentence: 'There ___ many reasons for this decision.'
e_hi: बहुवचन संज्ञा 'reasons' के लिये 'are' सही है।
e_en: Because 'reasons' is plural, the verb should be 'are'.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में त्रुटि को ढूंढें और सही करें: 'He have finished his work before the deadline.'
q_en: Identify and correct the error in: 'He have finished his work before the deadline.'
o_hi: He has finished his work before the deadline.
He had finished his work before the deadline.
He finished his work before the deadline.
He have finished his work before the deadline.
o_en: He has finished his work before the deadline.
He had finished his work before the deadline.
He finished his work before the deadline.
He have finished his work before the deadline.
e_hi: कर्ता 'He' तीसरे पुरुष एकवचन है, इसलिए सहायक क्रिया 'has' होनी चाहिए, 'have' नहीं: 'He has finished his work before the deadline.'
e_en: The subject 'He' is third-person singular, so the auxiliary must be 'has', not 'have': 'He has finished his work before the deadline.'

q_hi: वह लड़की, ___ पुस्तक पढ़ रही है, मेरी सहेली है।
q_en: The girl, ___ is reading a book, is my friend.
e_hi: यह उपवाक्य विषय 'girl' को दर्शाता है, अतः 'who' सही है।
e_en: The relative clause refers to the subject, so 'who' is correct.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य में सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the policy.'
q_en: Choose the correct verb: 'Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the policy.'
e_hi: समीपतम संज्ञा 'employees' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'are' सही है।
e_en: The verb agrees with the closer noun 'employees', which is plural, so 'are' is correct.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें जहाँ 'break the ice' का सही प्रयोग हुआ हो।
q_en: Choose the sentence where 'break the ice' is used correctly.
o_hi: They broke the ice by playing a game.
She broke the ice during the meeting.
He broke the ice with a joke.
They broke the ice by fixing the broken ice.
o_en: They broke the ice by playing a game.
She broke the ice during the meeting.
He broke the ice with a joke.
They broke the ice by fixing the broken ice.
e_hi: यह वाक्य 'बर्फ तोड़ने' के लिए उपयुक्त है, जहाँ एक चुटकुले से माहौल हल्का हुआ।
e_en: The idiom 'break the ice' means to initiate conversation, correctly used in 'He broke the ice with a joke.'

q_hi: इन वाक्यों में से कौन सा वाक्य संयुक्त विशेषण (compound adjective) रखता है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences contains a compound adjective?
o_hi: वह एक तेज़-रफ़्तार कार चलाती है।
वह ऊँची बिल्ली को चूमता है।
e_hi: ‘तेज़‑रफ़्तार’ एक संयुक्त विशेषण है जो दो शब्दों से बना है।
e_en: ‘Fast‑speed’ is a compound adjective formed by two words.

q_hi: वाक्य 'She has been studying for three hours.' का काल कौन सा है?
q_en: What is the tense of the sentence 'She has been studying for three hours.'?
e_hi: यह वाक्य वर्तमान परिपूर्ण निरंतर (Present Perfect Continuous) है क्योंकि यह ‘has been’ + ‘studying’ के साथ है।
e_en: The sentence uses Present Perfect Continuous tense, indicated by ‘has been’ + ‘studying’.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में से कौन सा वाक्य संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य (relative clause) रखता है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences contains a relative clause?
o_hi: मैंने वह किताब पढ़ी जिसे तुमने सुझाया।
o_en: I read the book that you recommended.
e_hi: ‘जिसे तुमने सुझाया’ एक संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य है।
e_en: ‘that you recommended’ is a relative clause.

q_hi: शब्द ‘quickly’ को किस प्रकार का संशोधक (modifier) माना जाता है?
q_en: Classify the word ‘quickly’ as an adverbial or adjectival modifier?
e_hi: ‘quickly’ क्रिया विशेषण है क्योंकि यह क्रिया को संशोधित करता है।
e_en: ‘Quickly’ is an adverb as it modifies a verb.

q_hi: वाक्य 'I will go, but you stay.' में प्रयुक्त संयोजक (conjunction) का प्रकार क्या है?
q_en: What type of conjunction is used in the sentence 'I will go, but you stay.'?
e_hi: ‘but’ एक समन्वयी संयोजक है जो दो स्वतंत्र वाक्यों को जोड़ता है।
e_en: ‘But’ is a coordinating conjunction linking two independent clauses.

q_hi: वाक्य 'Because she was late, the train missed her.' में उपवाक्य का प्रकार क्या है?
q_en: Classify the clause in the sentence 'Because she was late, the train missed her.'?
e_hi: ‘Because she was late’ एक कारण उपवाक्य (Causal Clause) है।
e_en: ‘Because she was late’ is a causal clause explaining the reason.

q_hi: वाक्य 'If I were you, I would apologize.' का व्याकरणिक मूड क्या है?
q_en: What is the grammatical mood of the sentence 'If I were you, I would apologize.'?
e_hi: यह वाक्य संभाव्य (Subjunctive) मूड का है क्योंकि यह काल्पनिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है।
e_en: The sentence is in Subjunctive mood, expressing a hypothetical situation.

q_hi: वाक्य 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog' में कुल कितने शब्द हैं?
q_en: How many words are in the sentence 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'?
e_hi: इस वाक्य में कुल नौ शब्द हैं।
e_en: The sentence contains nine words.

q_hi: वाक्य 'I went to the market, bought apples, and returned home' में कितने कॉमा हैं?
q_en: How many commas are in the sentence 'I went to the market, bought apples, and returned home'?
e_hi: इस वाक्य में दो कॉमा हैं।
e_en: The sentence has two commas.

q_hi: शब्द 'uncharacteristically' में कितने अक्षर हैं?
q_en: How many letters are in the word 'uncharacteristically'?
e_hi: इस शब्द में कुल 20 अक्षर हैं।
e_en: The word has 20 letters.

q_hi: वाक्यांश 'a beautiful day' में (स्पेस को छोड़कर) कितने अक्षर हैं?
q_en: In the phrase 'a beautiful day', how many characters are there excluding spaces?
e_hi: Excluding spaces: 'a' (1) + 'beautiful' (9) + 'day' (3) = 13 characters, matching the marked answer.
e_en: Excluding spaces: 'a' (1) + 'beautiful' (9) + 'day' (3) = 13 characters, matching the marked answer.

q_hi: पहली भारतीय रेलवे लाइन कब खोली गई थी?
q_en: When was the first Indian railway line opened?
e_hi: पहली भारतीय रेलवे लाइन 16 अप्रैल 1853 को खोली गई थी।
e_en: The first Indian railway line was opened on 16 April 1853.

q_hi: Choose the correct preposition for the sentence: "The railway station closes ___ 5 pm."
q_en: Choose the correct preposition for the sentence: "The railway station closes ___ 5 pm."
e_hi: The preposition 'at' is used to indicate a specific point in time: 'closes at 5 pm'.
e_en: The preposition 'at' is used to indicate a specific point in time: 'closes at 5 pm'.

q_hi: वाक्य "पहली लोकोमोटिव बनने के बाद रेलवे लाइन पहले से ही तैयार थी" में कौन सा काल सही है?
q_en: In the sentence "By the time the first locomotive was built, the railway line had already been laid", which tense is correctly used?
e_hi: यह वाक्य में 'had already been laid' पास्ट परफेक्ट पर्पजेसिव का प्रयोग है।
e_en: The phrase uses the past perfect passive to indicate an action completed before another past action.

q_hi: कौन सा विकल्प सही है: "Indian Railways ___ a major contributor to the economy."
q_en: Which option correctly completes: "Indian Railways ___ a major contributor to the economy."
e_hi: Indian Railways एक एकवचन संज्ञा है, अतः 'is' सही है।
e_en: Indian Railways is a singular noun, so the verb should be 'is'.

q_hi: सही रूप चुनें: "The locomotive ___ built in 1854 is preserved in the museum."
q_en: Choose the correct relative pronoun: "The locomotive ___ built in 1854 is preserved in the museum."
e_hi: इस उपवाक्य में अल्पविराम नहीं है, अतः यह प्रतिबंधात्मक (restrictive) उपवाक्य है; नियमानुसार ऐसे उपवाक्यों में 'which' के स्थान पर 'that' का प्रयोग होता है।
e_en: The clause has no commas, making it restrictive; the conventional rule is that restrictive clauses use 'that', not 'which'.

q_hi: कौन सा विकल्प सही है: "The man ___ car was stolen."
q_en: Which option correctly fills the blank: "The man ___ car was stolen."
e_hi: "whose" स्वामित्व दर्शाता है।
e_en: "whose" indicates possession.

q_hi: वाक्य "The train is scheduled ___ 6 pm to reach by 9 pm." में सही शब्द कौन सा है?
q_en: In the sentence "The train is scheduled ___ 6 pm to reach by 9 pm," which word is correct?
e_hi: 'At' indicates the specific scheduled time: 'The train is scheduled at 6 pm to reach by 9 pm.' 'To' does not fit this slot grammatically.
e_en: 'At' indicates the specific scheduled time: 'The train is scheduled at 6 pm to reach by 9 pm.' 'To' does not fit this slot grammatically.

q_hi: वाक्य "The Golden Quadrilateral project was launched ___ 2002." में सही पूर्वसर्ग कौन सा है?
q_en: In the sentence "The Golden Quadrilateral project was launched ___ 2002," which preposition is correct?
e_hi: वर्ष बताने के लिये "in" सही है।
e_en: The preposition "in" is correct for indicating a year.

q_hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: "The railway was established ___ the British in 1853."
q_en: Choose the correct tense for the verb phrase: "The railway was established ___ the British in 1853."
e_hi: यह वाक्य पासिव सिम्पल पास्ट में है।
e_en: The sentence is in passive simple past tense.

q_hi: वह कल बाज़ार ___ गई।
q_en: She ___ to the market yesterday.
e_hi: "गई" भूतकाल का सरल रूप है, जो पूर्ण क्रिया को दर्शाता है।
e_en: "went" is the simple past tense of "go", indicating a completed action.

q_hi: केक में चीनी मिलाने के बाद वह ___ स्वादिष्ट लगता है।
q_en: The cake tastes ___ after adding sugar.
e_hi: "बेहतर" का अर्थ "अच्छा से बेहतर" है।
e_en: "better" means "more good" or "improved".

q_hi: वह पाँच वर्षों से यहाँ ___ काम कर रहा है।
q_en: He has been working here ___ five years.
e_hi: "के लिये" अवधि को दर्शाता है, इसलिए सही विकल्प "for" है।
e_en: "for" indicates a duration, which is the correct preposition.

q_hi: भुगतान के लिए धनराशि ___ अभी तय नहीं हुई है।
q_en: The amount of money ___ to be paid is not yet decided.
e_hi: "जिस" का प्रयोग संज्ञा वाक्यांश के लिए होता है।
e_en: "that" is the relative pronoun used for a noun phrase.

q_hi: वह पहला व्यक्ति ___ नई नीति को देख चुका था।
q_en: She was the first person ___ had seen the new policy.
e_hi: After superlative-like expressions such as 'the first', 'that' is the traditionally preferred relative pronoun: 'She was the first person that had seen the new policy.'
e_en: After superlative-like expressions such as 'the first', 'that' is the traditionally preferred relative pronoun: 'She was the first person that had seen the new policy.'

q_hi: वह अपनी बहन के बराबर ऊँची है। "She is as tall as _______"
q_en: She is as tall as _______.
e_hi: यह वाक्य "as ... as" तुलनात्मक संरचना का प्रयोग करता है, जहाँ समानता को दर्शाया जाता है। इसलिए सही उत्तर "उसकी बहन" है।
e_en: This sentence uses the "as ... as" comparative structure to express equality. Hence the correct answer is "her sister".

q_hi: लाल और नीले को मिलाने पर रंग क्या बनता है? "Mixing red and blue gives _______"
q_en: Mixing red and blue gives _______.
e_hi: रंगों का मिश्रण करते समय लाल + नीला = बैंगनी।
e_en: When mixing primary colors red and blue, the resulting color is purple.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही है? "The train is _______ than the bus."
q_en: Which sentence is correct? "The train is _______ than the bus."
e_hi: सही रूप 'faster' है। "fasterer" और "more faster" व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत हैं।
e_en: The correct form is 'faster'. 'fasterer' and 'more faster' are grammatically incorrect.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही है? "Neither the teacher nor the students _______ to the exam."
q_en: Which sentence is correct? "Neither the teacher nor the students _______ to the exam."
e_hi: 'Went' is the simple past tense, which does not change form for singular or plural subjects, so it fits regardless of which subject ('the teacher' or 'the students') is considered nearer under the proximity rule.
e_en: 'Went' is the simple past tense, which does not change form for singular or plural subjects, so it fits regardless of which subject ('the teacher' or 'the students') is considered nearer under the proximity rule.

q_hi: हिंदी शब्द 'कोई' का सही अंग्रेज़ी अनुवाद कौन सा है?
q_en: Which English word translates the Hindi word 'कोई'?
e_hi: "कोई" का अर्थ "any" होता है।
e_en: "कोई" translates to "any" in English.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही है? "She has more books than I have."
q_en: Which sentence is correct? "She has more books than I have."
o_hi: She has more books than I have.
She has more books than I has.
She has more books than I had.
She has more books than I hads.
o_en: She has more books than I have.
She has more books than I has.
She has more books than I had.
She has more books than I hads.
e_hi: सही वाक्य में क्रिया "have" का प्रयोग किया गया है, जो विषय "I" के साथ मेल खाता है।
e_en: The correct sentence uses the verb "have" to match the subject "I".

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य "as ... as" के सही प्रयोग को दर्शाता है? "The river is _______ wide as the road."
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses "as ... as"? "The river is _______ wide as the road."
e_hi: समानता दिखाने के लिये "as ... as" का प्रयोग होता है, अतः "as" सही है।
e_en: The structure "as ... as" is used to show equality, so "as" is correct.

q_hi: कौन सा कथन सही है? "If it rains, we will go to the market."
q_en: Which statement is correct? "If it rains, we will go to the market."
o_hi: If it rains, we will go to the market.
If it rained, we will go to the market.
If it rains, we will going to the market.
If it rain, we will go to the market.
o_en: If it rains, we will go to the market.
If it rained, we will go to the market.
If it rains, we will going to the market.
If it rain, we will go to the market.
e_hi: सही शर्तीय वाक्य में वर्तमान काल का प्रयोग होता है, अतः "If it rains" सही है।
e_en: The correct conditional sentence uses the present tense in the if-clause: "If it rains".

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य "either ... or" के सही प्रयोग को दर्शाता है? "You can _______ tea or coffee."
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses "either ... or"? "You can _______ tea or coffee."
e_hi: सही वाक्य में "either" का प्रयोग किया गया है।
e_en: The correct sentence uses "either".

q_hi: वह हर सुबह 6 बजे ___ उठता है।
q_en: Choose the correct verb form: He ______ at 6 every morning.
e_hi: सही उत्तर ‘जागता है’ है क्योंकि यह वर्तमान काल का सही रूप है।
e_en: Correct answer is ‘wakes up’ as it matches the present tense.

q_hi: मैं ___ कल स्कूल गया।
q_en: I ___ to school yesterday.
e_hi: यहाँ भूतकाल का सही रूप ‘गया’ है।
e_en: Here the correct past tense form is ‘went’.

q_hi: वह ___ से बहुत खुश है।
q_en: She is very happy ___.
e_hi: 'Happy with her success' correctly uses the preposition 'with' plus a possessive noun phrase.
e_en: 'Happy with her success' correctly uses the preposition 'with' plus a possessive noun phrase.

q_hi: संगीत का सही अर्थ चुनें।
q_en: Choose the meaning of ‘संगीत’.
e_hi: ‘संगीत’ का अर्थ ‘music’ है।
e_en: ‘संगीत’ means ‘music’.

q_hi: फैक्ट्री की मशीनरी खराब हो गई, ___ उत्पादन रोक दिया गया।
q_en: The factory's machinery malfunctioned, ___ production was halted.
e_hi: मशीनरी के खराब होने से उत्पादन रोका गया, इसलिए यह परिणामस्वरूप हुआ।
e_en: The malfunction caused the halt; 'therefore' links the effect.

q_hi: वह सारी रात पढ़ाई कर रही थी, ___ उसने परीक्षा में बेहतरीन अंक प्राप्त किए।
q_en: She had studied all night, ___ she passed the exam with flying colors.
e_hi: सभी रात पढ़ाई करने के कारण उसने परीक्षा में अच्छा अंक प्राप्त किया।
e_en: Studying all night led to success; 'because' indicates the reason.

q_hi: The sudden drop in temperature ___ the crops to suffer frost damage.
q_en: The sudden drop in temperature ___ the crops to suffer frost damage.
e_hi: 'Caused' fits the construction 'caused + object + to + verb': 'caused the crops to suffer frost damage.'
e_en: 'Caused' fits the construction 'caused + object + to + verb': 'caused the crops to suffer frost damage.'

q_hi: क्योंकि पुल संरचनात्मक रूप से अस्थिर था, ___ अभियंता ने इसे ध्वस्त करने का निर्णय लिया।
q_en: Since the bridge was structurally unsound, ___ the engineers decided to demolish it.
e_hi: पुल अस्थिर था, इसलिए अभियंता ने उसे ध्वस्त करने का निर्णय लिया।
e_en: Because the bridge was unsafe, 'therefore' shows the consequence.

q_hi: सरकार का ईंधन कर बढ़ाने का निर्णय, ___ सार्वजनिक विरोध, ईंधन बिक्री में कमी का कारण बना।
q_en: The government's decision to increase fuel taxes, ___ the public's protests, resulted in a decline in fuel sales.
e_hi: सार्वजनिक विरोध के बावजूद, कर बढ़ाने के बावजूद भी बिक्री घट गई।
e_en: 'Despite' introduces a contrast; the tax hike still caused decline.

q_hi: अगर ट्रेन समय पर पहुंचती है, ___ यात्रियों को कनेक्टिंग बस नहीं चूकनी पड़ेगी।
q_en: If the train arrives on time, ___ passengers will not miss the connecting bus.
e_hi: अगर ट्रेन समय पर पहुँचती है, तब यात्रियों को बस नहीं चूकनी पड़ेगी।
e_en: 'Then' denotes the resulting condition in a conditional sentence.

q_hi: नई नीति लागू की गई, ___ कर्मचारियों को मासिक रिपोर्ट जमा करनी पड़ी।
q_en: The new policy was introduced, ___ employees were required to submit monthly reports.
e_hi: नई नीति लागू होने के कारण कर्मचारियों को रिपोर्ट जमा करनी पड़ी।
e_en: 'Therefore' connects the policy introduction to the requirement.

q_hi: भारी बर्फबारी के कारण, ___ कई स्कूल बंद हो गए।
q_en: The heavy snowfall, ___ many schools were closed.
e_hi: भारी बर्फबारी के कारण कई स्कूल बंद हो गए; 'इसलिए' इसका परिणाम दर्शाता है।
e_en: 'Therefore' explains that the snowfall caused closures.

q_hi: शिक्षक ने छात्रों की प्रशंसा की, ___ वे अध्ययन में और प्रेरित हुए।
q_en: The teacher praised the students, ___ they felt motivated to study harder.
e_hi: शिक्षक की प्रशंसा के कारण छात्र और प्रेरित हुए; 'इसलिए' कारण-परिणाम दिखाता है।
e_en: 'Therefore' links praise to motivation.

q_hi: शब्द 'चलना' किस भाग से संबंधित है? ____
q_en: The word 'run' is an example of which part of speech? ____
e_hi: क्रिया 'चलना' एक क्रिया (verb) है, जो क्रिया को दर्शाती है।
e_en: The word 'run' is a verb, indicating an action.

q_hi: पशुओं के वर्गीकरण में, स्तनधारी ______ होते हैं।
q_en: In the classification of animals, mammals are ______.
e_hi: स्तनधारी गर्म रक्त वाले होते हैं, इसलिए यह सही वर्गीकरण है।
e_en: Mammals are warm-blooded organisms, which is the correct classification.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्राथमिक रंग है? ____
q_en: Which of the following is a primary color? ____
e_hi: लाल, नीला और पीला प्राथमिक रंग हैं।
e_en: Red, blue and yellow are primary colors.

q_hi: फल को उसके रंग के आधार पर वर्गीकृत करने के लिए कौन सी श्रेणी प्रयोग की जाती है? ____
q_en: Which category is used to classify fruit based on its color? ____
e_hi: फल को रंग के आधार पर वर्गीकृत करने के लिए रंग श्रेणी का उपयोग किया जाता है।
e_en: The color category is used to classify fruit based on its hue.

q_hi: फिशिंग ईमेल को किस श्रेणी में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है? ____
q_en: Phishing emails are classified under which category? ____
e_hi: फिशिंग ईमेल को अनचाहे (unsolicited) ईमेल के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।
e_en: Phishing emails are classified as unsolicited emails.

q_hi: कौन सी भाषा सिनो-तिब्बती भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है? ____
q_en: Which of the following languages belongs to the Sino‑Tibetan family? ____
e_hi: मंदारिन चीनी भाषा सिनो-तिब्बती भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है।
e_en: Mandarin Chinese belongs to the Sino‑Tibetan language family.

q_hi: किस तारा वर्ग में सबसे गर्म तारे पाए जाते हैं? ____
q_en: Which spectral class contains the hottest stars? ____
e_hi: O वर्ग के तारे सबसे गर्म होते हैं।
e_en: Stars in the O spectral class are the hottest.

q_hi: कॉपर किस धातु वर्ग में आता है? ____
q_en: Copper belongs to which class of metals? ____
e_hi: कॉपर एक संक्रमण धातु (transition metal) है।
e_en: Copper is a transition metal.

q_hi: शताब्दी ट्रेनें किस श्रेणी की हैं? ____
q_en: Shatabdi trains belong to which category? ____
e_hi: Shatabdi trains are a category of high-speed express trains in Indian Railways, so 'express' is the correct category.
e_en: Shatabdi trains are a category of high-speed express trains in Indian Railways, so 'express' is the correct category.

q_hi: महाकाव्य किस साहित्यिक जेनर में आता है? ____
q_en: Epic belongs to which literary genre? ____
e_hi: An epic is a long narrative poem, so it falls under the poetry genre.
e_en: An epic is a long narrative poem, so it falls under the poetry genre.

q_hi: During his journey, a person felt extremely exhausted and immediately went _______.
q_en: During his journey, a person felt extremely exhausted and immediately went _______.
e_hi: Feeling exhausted, the person went to bed to rest.
e_en: Feeling exhausted, the person went to bed to rest.

q_hi: राहुल ने अपने प्रोजेक्ट के लिए आवश्यक डेटा एकत्र किया, लेकिन उसे अभी भी _______ की जरूरत थी।
q_en: Rahul gathered the necessary data for his project, but he still needed _______.
e_hi: यहाँ "समीक्षा" सही है क्योंकि डेटा के बाद प्रोजेक्ट को समीक्षा की आवश्यकता होती है।
e_en: Here "review" is correct as the project requires a review after gathering data.

q_hi: Due to heavy rain on the road, there was a traffic _______.
q_en: Due to heavy rain on the road, there was a traffic _______.
e_hi: Heavy rain commonly causes a traffic obstruction (blockage).
e_en: Heavy rain commonly causes a traffic obstruction (blockage).

q_hi: कंपनी ने नया सॉफ्टवेयर लागू किया, जिसके बाद ग्राहक सेवा की गुणवत्ता में _______ हुआ।
q_en: After implementing the new software, the quality of customer service _______.
e_hi: सही उत्तर "बढ़ी" है क्योंकि नई तकनीक से सेवा की गुणवत्ता सुधरी।
e_en: The correct answer is "increased" because the new technology improved service quality.

q_hi: शिक्षक ने छात्रों को प्रश्नपत्र पर दिए गए निर्देशों को _______ पढ़ने के लिए कहा।
q_en: The teacher asked students to read the instructions on the exam paper _______.
e_hi: सही विकल्प "सावधानीपूर्वक" है क्योंकि निर्देशों को ध्यान से पढ़ना ज़रूरी है।
e_en: The correct choice is "carefully" as it implies reading the instructions attentively.

q_hi: वह अपनी नई नौकरी में बहुत उत्साहित था, इसलिए उसने अपने बॉस को एक _______ भेजा।
q_en: He was very excited about his new job, so he sent a _______ to his boss.
e_hi: सही विकल्प "धन्यवाद" है क्योंकि नौकरी मिलने पर कृतज्ञता जताई जाती है।
e_en: The correct option is "thank you" as gratitude is expressed upon getting a new job.

q_hi: संगठन ने अपनी वार्षिक रिपोर्ट को प्रकाशित करने के लिए _______ का उपयोग किया।
q_en: The organization used _______ to publish its annual report.
e_hi: यहाँ "पोर्टल" सही है क्योंकि रिपोर्ट ऑनलाइन प्रकाशित की जाती है।
e_en: Here "portal" is correct because the report is published online.

q_hi: परीक्षा के दौरान, छात्र ने प्रश्न को पढ़ने के बाद उसे _______ समझा।
q_en: During the exam, after reading the question, the student realized it was _______.
e_hi: सही उत्तर "सरल" है क्योंकि प्रश्न स्पष्ट और आसान था।
e_en: The correct answer is "simple" because the question was clear and easy.

q_hi: उद्यमी ने अपने उत्पाद को बाजार में _______ करने के लिए एक नई रणनीति अपनाई।
q_en: The entrepreneur adopted a new strategy to _______ his product in the market.
e_hi: सही विकल्प "प्रचार" है क्योंकि मार्केटिंग में प्रचार प्रमुख है।
e_en: The correct option is "promote" as marketing focuses on promotion.

q_hi: किसी भी परियोजना की सफलता के लिए, टीम को एक स्पष्ट _______ की आवश्यकता होती है।
q_en: For any project's success, the team needs a clear _______.
e_hi: सही उत्तर "उद्देश्य" है क्योंकि स्पष्ट लक्ष्य सफलता के लिये आवश्यक है।
e_en: The correct answer is "objective" as a clear goal is essential for success.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में से सही वाक्य कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is correct?
o_hi: वह निराश थी क्योंकि उसने परीक्षा में असफलता पाई, जिसने उसे आत्मविश्वास खोने का कारण बना।
वह निराश थी क्योंकि उसने परीक्षा में असफलता पाई, जिसने उसे आत्मविश्वास खोने का कारण बनता है।
वह निराश थी क्योंकि उसने परीक्षा में असफलता पाई, जिससे उसे आत्मविश्वास खोने का कारण बना।
वह निराश थी क्योंकि उसने परीक्षा में असफलता पाई, जिससे उसे आत्मविश्वास खोने का कारण बनता है।
o_en: She was disappointed because she failed the exam, which made her lose confidence.
She was disappointed because she failed the exam, which makes her lose confidence.
She was disappointed because she failed the exam, which caused her to lose confidence.
She was disappointed because she failed the exam, which causes her to lose confidence.
e_hi: इस वाक्य में ‘बनाता है’ का प्रयोग गलत है; सही रूप ‘बनाया’ होना चाहिए।
e_en: The clause uses the wrong tense; it should be ‘made’ (past) instead of ‘makes’.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में से कौन सा वाक्य ‘than’ के प्रयोग में त्रुटि रखता है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences has an error in the use of ‘than’?
o_en: He is taller than me is.
e_hi: वाक्य ‘वह मुझसे बड़ा है मैं’ में ‘मैं’ का प्रयोग गलत है।
e_en: The sentence ‘He is taller than me is’ incorrectly uses ‘is’ after ‘than’ and misplaces the pronoun.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही है?
q_en: Which sentence is correct?
e_hi: सही वाक्य "He has gone to market." है क्योंकि present perfect में ‘have/has + past participle’ का प्रयोग होता है।
e_en: The correct sentence is "He has gone to market." because present perfect uses ‘has/have + past participle’.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: "The committee which was formed last week has been meeting daily."
q_en: Choose the correct sentence:
o_hi: The committee which was formed last week has been meeting daily.
The committee that was formed last week has been meeting daily.
The committee which was formed last week have been meeting daily.
The committee that was formed last week have been meeting daily.
o_en: The committee which was formed last week has been meeting daily.
The committee that was formed last week has been meeting daily.
The committee which was formed last week have been meeting daily.
The committee that was formed last week have been meeting daily.
e_hi: सही वाक्य "The committee that was formed last week has been meeting daily." है क्योंकि ‘that’ सही relative pronoun है और क्रिया ‘has’ एकवचन है।
e_en: The correct sentence is "The committee that was formed last week has been meeting daily." because ‘that’ is the appropriate relative pronoun and the verb ‘has’ agrees with singular subject.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: "She have a book."
q_en: Identify the error in the sentence: "She have a book."
e_hi: वाक्य में विषय-क्रिया का मेल सही नहीं है। 'She' एक एकवचन सर्वनाम है, इसलिए क्रिया को 'has' होना चाहिए।
e_en: The subject–verb agreement is wrong. 'She' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

q_hi: सही शब्द कौन सा है: "The new policy will have a great affect on the economy."
q_en: Choose the correct word: "The new policy will have a great affect on the economy."
e_hi: यहाँ 'effect' (परिणाम) सही है। 'affect' क्रिया है।
e_en: Here 'effect' (noun meaning result) is correct. 'affect' is a verb.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में त्रुटि खोजें: "Running through the park, the birds were singing."
q_en: Find the error in the sentence: "Running through the park, the birds were singing."
e_hi: 'Running through the park' को सही ढंग से जोड़ने के लिए विषय को स्पष्ट होना चाहिए; यहाँ यह डैंगलिंग मॉडिफायर है।
e_en: The participial phrase 'Running through the park' is dangling because it does not refer to any noun in the sentence.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में त्रुटि खोजें: "I don't need no help."
q_en: Find the error in the sentence: "I don't need no help."
e_hi: यह वाक्य दो नकारात्मक शब्द 'don't' और 'no' को एक साथ रखता है, जिससे डबल नकारात्मक बनता है।
e_en: The sentence contains a double negative with 'don't' and 'no', making it ungrammatical.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा फल नहीं है?
q_en: Which of the following words is not a fruit?
e_hi: पानी एक तरल है और यह किसी फल का हिस्सा नहीं है।
e_en: Water is a liquid and not a fruit.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द 'उत्साह' का समानार्थी नहीं है?
q_en: Which of the following words is not a synonym of 'उत्साह'?
e_hi: उत्सव एक त्योहार है, जिसका अर्थ 'उत्साह' से अलग है।
e_en: Festival is a celebration and differs in meaning from enthusiasm.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द क्रिया है?
q_en: Which of the following words is a verb?
e_hi: 'पढ़ना' एक क्रिया है, जबकि अन्य शब्द संज्ञा या विशेषण हैं।
e_en: 'Read' is a verb; the others are nouns or adjectives.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द 'उपयोगी' का विपरीत है?
q_en: Which of the following words is the antonym of 'उपयोगी'?
e_hi: 'निरुपयोगी' का अर्थ है 'उपयोगी नहीं'।
e_en: 'Useless' means not useful, the opposite of 'उपयोगी'.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द संज्ञा नहीं है?
q_en: Which of the following words is NOT a noun?
e_hi: 'Happy' is an adjective, while 'Happiness', 'Joy', and 'Joyfulness' are all nouns, so 'Happy' is the one that is NOT a noun.
e_en: 'Happy' is an adjective, while 'Happiness', 'Joy', and 'Joyfulness' are all nouns, so 'Happy' is the one that is NOT a noun.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द वाहन का प्रकार है?
q_en: Which of the following is a type of vehicle?
e_hi: साइकिल एक परिवहन साधन है।
e_en: Bicycle is a mode of transport.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा पौधा है पर फल नहीं?
q_en: Which of the following is a plant but not a fruit?
e_hi: गुलाब एक फूलदार पौधा है, फल नहीं।
e_en: Rose is a flowering plant, not a fruit.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द क्रिया विशेषण नहीं है?
q_en: Which of the following words is NOT an adverb?
e_hi: 'सभी' एक सर्वनाम/विशेषण है, क्रिया विशेषण नहीं।
e_en: 'All' is a pronoun/adjective, not an adverb.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा उपसर्ग है?
q_en: Which of the following is a prefix?
e_hi: 'अन-' एक उपसर्ग है, अन्य शब्द शब्दमूल या संपूर्ण शब्द हैं।
e_en: 'Un-' is a prefix; the others are not.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द 'वर्गीकरण करना' का अर्थ रखता है?
q_en: Which of the following words means 'to classify or categorize'?
e_hi: 'वर्गीकरण' शब्द का अर्थ होता है वस्तुओं को श्रेणियों में बाँटना।
e_en: 'Classify' means to arrange items into categories.

q_hi: किसी वस्तु को उसके गुणों के आधार पर श्रेणीबद्ध करने की क्रिया को क्या कहते हैं?
q_en: What is the action of arranging something based on its characteristics called?
e_hi: वर्गीकरण वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें वस्तुओं को गुणों के अनुसार समूहित किया जाता है।
e_en: Classification is the process of grouping items according to their traits.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द 'शब्दों के अर्थ के आधार पर समूह बनाना' की प्रक्रिया को दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which word denotes the process of grouping words based on their meanings?
e_hi: वर्गीकरण वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें शब्दों को उनके अर्थ के अनुसार व्यवस्थित किया जाता है।
e_en: Classification is the process of arranging words according to their meanings.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द 'श्रेणियों में विभाजित करना' के अर्थ में है?
q_en: Which of the following words means 'to divide into categories'?
e_hi: 'वर्गीकरण' का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु को श्रेणियों में बाँटना, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी 'वर्गीकरण' ही है।
e_en: 'Classification' means to divide something into categories; its synonym is 'Classification' itself in this context.

q_hi: किसी वस्तु को उसके गुणों के आधार पर उप-समूहों में बाँटने को क्या कहते हैं?
q_en: What is the act of subdividing an object into subgroups based on its properties called?
e_hi: उपवर्गीकरण वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें किसी बड़ी श्रेणी को छोटे उप-समूहों में बाँटा जाता है।
e_en: Subcategorization is the process of dividing a larger category into smaller subgroups.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा शब्द 'वर्गीकरण के स्तर' को दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which of the following words represents a level in classification?
e_hi: जैविक वर्गीकरण में 'प्रजाति' एक स्तर है।
e_en: In biological taxonomy, 'species' is a level of classification.

q_hi: शब्द 'क्लस्टर' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What is the correct meaning of the word 'cluster'?
o_hi: किसी समूह को एक साथ लाना
e_hi: 'क्लस्टर' का अर्थ है किसी समूह को एक साथ लाना या समूहीकृत करना।
e_en: 'Cluster' means to bring items together or group them.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द 'वर्गीकरण के आधार पर क्रमबद्ध करना' को दर्शाता है?
q_en: Which word indicates arranging based on classification?
e_hi: ऑर्डरिंग (क्रम देना) किसी वर्गीकरण के आधार पर वस्तुओं को व्यवस्थित करने की प्रक्रिया है।
e_en: Ordering is the process of arranging items based on a classification scheme.

q_hi: किस शब्द का अर्थ 'किसी चीज़ को श्रेणियों में विभाजित करना' है?
q_en: Which word means 'to divide something into categories'?
e_hi: 'वर्गीकरण' ही वह शब्द है जो किसी वस्तु को श्रेणियों में बाँटने की क्रिया को दर्शाता है।
e_en: 'Classification' is the word that denotes the act of dividing something into categories.

q_hi: शब्द 'हाइरार्की' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What is the correct meaning of the word 'hierarchy'?
e_hi: 'हाइरार्की' का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु को स्तरों या रैंक के अनुसार व्यवस्थित करना।
e_en: 'Hierarchy' means arranging something in levels or ranks.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द 'वर्गीकरण' के विपरीत अर्थ रखता है?
q_en: Which of the following words has a meaning opposite to 'classification'?
e_hi: 'Classification' means organizing things into orderly categories; its opposite is 'confusion' (disorder, lack of organization).
e_en: 'Classification' means organizing things into orderly categories; its opposite is 'confusion' (disorder, lack of organization).

q_hi: किस शब्द का अर्थ ‘उत्साही’ के बराबर है?
q_en: Which word is synonymous with 'enthusiastic'?
e_hi: 'Eager' means showing great interest and enthusiasm, a synonym for 'enthusiastic'.
e_en: 'Eager' means showing great interest and enthusiasm, a synonym for 'enthusiastic'.

q_hi: यदि दो कार्यक्रम एक ही समय पर नहीं चल सकते, तो वे _______ नहीं हैं।
q_en: If two programs cannot run at the same time, they are not _______.
e_hi: यहाँ ‘संगत’ का अर्थ है एक-दूसरे के साथ मेल खाने वाला।
e_en: Here ‘compatible’ means able to coexist or work together without conflict.

q_hi: किस शब्द का अर्थ ‘बिना तुलना के’ है?
q_en: Which word means ‘unparalleled’?
e_hi: 'Unique' (having no equal) is the closest synonym to 'unparalleled'.
e_en: 'Unique' (having no equal) is the closest synonym to 'unparalleled'.

q_hi: उसका निर्णय _______ था, जिससे सभी प्रभावित हुए।
q_en: His decision was _______, which impressed everyone.
e_hi: यहाँ ‘अचूक’ का मतलब है बिना किसी त्रुटि या गलती के।
e_en: ‘Flawless’ means without any error or mistake.

q_hi: उसे अपनी बातों से सुनने वालों को _______ करना पसंद है।
q_en: He likes to _______ his listeners with his words.
e_hi: ‘भ्रमित करना’ का अर्थ है किसी को गलत समझने या गुमराह करने के लिए अस्पष्ट करना।
e_en: ‘Confuse’ means to make unclear or misleading.

q_hi: किस शब्द का अर्थ ‘किसी क्षणिक अवधि का’ है?
q_en: Which word means ‘short-lived’?
e_hi: 'Temporary' means lasting for a short time, a synonym for 'short-lived'.
e_en: 'Temporary' means lasting for a short time, a synonym for 'short-lived'.

q_hi: वह अपनी बातों में _______ रहता है।
q_en: He is _______ in his speech.
e_hi: ‘संक्षिप्त’ का अर्थ है कम शब्दों में स्पष्ट रूप से बताना।
e_en: ‘Brief’ means to express something clearly in few words.

q_hi: Which word means 'deviating from the norm'?
q_en: Which word means 'deviating from the norm'?
e_hi: 'Unusual' means deviating from what is normal or expected, a synonym for 'anomalous'.
e_en: 'Unusual' means deviating from what is normal or expected, a synonym for 'anomalous'.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द ‘सामाजिक, मिलनसार’ के समानार्थी है?
q_en: Which word is synonymous with ‘gregarious’?
e_hi: ‘सामाजिक’ का मतलब है दूसरों के साथ मिलकर काम करने या रहने की प्रवृत्ति।
e_en: ‘Social’ means having a tendency to interact or live with others.

q_hi: किस शब्द का अर्थ ‘सतत और विश्वसनीय’ है?
q_en: Which word means ‘reliable and enduring’?
e_hi: 'Trustworthy' means reliable and dependable.
e_en: 'Trustworthy' means reliable and dependable.

q_hi: कौन सा शब्द "मिहनत" का पर्याय है?
q_en: Which word is a synonym of "diligent"?
e_hi: उद्योगी का मतलब है मेहनती और परिश्रमी।
e_en: Industrious means hardworking and diligent.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा "दुर्लभ" का विपरीत है?
q_en: Which of the following words is the antonym of "scarce"?
e_hi: प्रचुर का अर्थ है बहुतायत, जो दुर्लभ का विपरीत है।
e_en: Abundant means plentiful, which is the opposite of scarce.

q_hi: "उसका तर्क इतना ___ था कि दर्शक उसे अस्वीकार करना मुश्किल पाते थे।"
q_en: His argument was so ___ that the audience found it hard to disagree.
e_hi: 'Persuasive' means capable of convincing or influencing, which best fits an argument the audience found hard to disagree with.
e_en: 'Persuasive' means capable of convincing or influencing, which best fits an argument the audience found hard to disagree with.

q_hi: "good" का तुलनात्मक रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following is the comparative form of "good"?
e_hi: बेहतर "good" का तुलनात्मक रूप है।
e_en: Better is the comparative form of good.

q_hi: "उसे ___ हास्यबोध है, जो सूक्ष्म बुद्धि से लोगों को हँसाता है।"
q_en: She has a ___ sense of humor, often making people laugh with subtle wit.
e_hi: सूखा हास्यबोध का मतलब है सूक्ष्म और तिरछा हास्य।
e_en: Dry humor refers to subtle, understated wit.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से "किफ़ायती" का पर्याय कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following is a synonym for "frugal"?
e_hi: बचतशील का अर्थ है खर्च में संयम रखना।
e_en: Thrifty means being careful with money or resources.

q_hi: "short" का श्रेष्ठतम रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which word is a superlative form of "short"?
e_hi: shortest का मतलब सबसे छोटा होता है।
e_en: Shortest means the smallest or most short.

q_hi: "intelligent" का तुलनात्मक रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following words is a comparative of "intelligent"?
e_hi: smarter का अर्थ है अधिक बुद्धिमान।
e_en: Smarter means more intelligent.

q_hi: "कमीशन के निर्णय पर जनता से ___ आलोचना हुई।"
q_en: The committee's decision was met with ___ criticism from the public.
e_hi: तीखी आलोचना का मतलब है कठोर या तीव्र।
e_en: Sharp criticism is harsh or intense.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से "प्रचुर" का पर्याय कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following words is a synonym of "abundant" that also means "plentiful"?
e_hi: भरपूर का मतलब है बहुतायत।
e_en: Copious means plentiful or abundant.

q_hi: "किसी चीज़ का ___ होना" का सही वाक्य क्या है?
q_en: Which sentence correctly uses "to be ___"?
e_hi: सही वाक्य है "I am more than happy"।
e_en: The correct sentence is "I am more than happy."

q_hi: शब्द 'abundant' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does the word 'abundant' mean?
e_hi: 'Abundant' means plentiful, existing in large quantity.
e_en: 'Abundant' means plentiful, existing in large quantity.

q_hi: शब्द 'ameliorate' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does 'ameliorate' mean?
e_hi: 'Ameliorate' का मतलब सुधारना या बेहतर बनाना होता है।
e_en: 'Ameliorate' means to improve or make better.

q_hi: शब्द 'incongruous' का सही अर्थ चुनें।
q_en: Choose the correct meaning of 'incongruous'.
e_hi: 'Incongruous' means out of place or not in harmony with its surroundings.
e_en: 'Incongruous' means out of place or not in harmony with its surroundings.

q_hi: शब्द 'delineate' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does 'delineate' mean?
e_hi: 'Delineate' means to outline or describe in detail.
e_en: 'Delineate' means to outline or describe in detail.

q_hi: शब्द 'ephemeral' का सही अर्थ चुनें।
q_en: Choose the correct meaning of 'ephemeral'.
e_hi: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time, a synonym for 'fleeting'.
e_en: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time, a synonym for 'fleeting'.

q_hi: शब्द 'obfuscate' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does 'obfuscate' mean?
e_hi: 'Obfuscate' means to make something unclear or obscure.
e_en: 'Obfuscate' means to make something unclear or obscure.

q_hi: शब्द 'expedite' का सही अर्थ चुनें।
q_en: Choose the correct meaning of 'expedite'.
e_hi: 'Expedite' means to speed up a process, a synonym for 'hasten'.
e_en: 'Expedite' means to speed up a process, a synonym for 'hasten'.

q_hi: शब्द 'palpable' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does 'palpable' mean?
e_hi: 'Palpable' means able to be felt or clearly noticeable, a synonym for 'tangible'.
e_en: 'Palpable' means able to be felt or clearly noticeable, a synonym for 'tangible'.

q_hi: शब्द 'recalcitrant' का सही अर्थ चुनें।
q_en: Choose the correct meaning of 'recalcitrant'.
e_hi: 'Recalcitrant' means stubbornly resistant to authority, a synonym for 'defiant'.
e_en: 'Recalcitrant' means stubbornly resistant to authority, a synonym for 'defiant'.

q_hi: शब्द 'cogent' का अर्थ क्या है?
q_en: What does 'cogent' mean?
e_hi: 'Cogent' means clear, logical, and convincing.
e_en: 'Cogent' means clear, logical, and convincing.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से 'abundant' (प्रचुर) के समानार्थी कौन सा है?
q_en: Which of the following words is most similar in meaning to 'abundant'?
e_hi: 'Abundant' means plentiful, existing in large quantity.
e_en: 'Abundant' means plentiful, existing in large quantity.

q_hi: वाक्य में सही तुलनात्मक शब्द चुनें: 'She is ____ than her brother.'
q_en: Choose the correct comparative word to complete: 'She is ____ than her brother.'
e_hi: यहाँ तुलनात्मक रूप 'taller' सही है क्योंकि तुलना की जा रही है।
e_en: The comparative form 'taller' is correct for comparing height.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से 'good' का सही तुलनात्मक रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which is the correct comparative form of 'good'?
e_hi: 'better' 'good' का तुलनात्मक रूप है।
e_en: 'better' is the comparative of 'good'.

q_hi: 'smart' विशेषण का सर्वोच्च रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which is the superlative form of the adjective 'smart'?
e_hi: 'smartest' 'smart' का सर्वोच्च रूप है।
e_en: 'smartest' is the superlative form of 'smart'.

q_hi: वाक्य में सही शब्द चुनें: 'The test was ____ than the previous one.'
q_en: Choose the correct word to complete: 'The test was ____ than the previous one.'
e_hi: 'harder' 'hard' का तुलनात्मक रूप है, जिसका अर्थ कठिन है।
e_en: 'harder' is the comparative of 'hard', meaning more difficult.

q_hi: 'bad' का सर्वोच्च रूप कौन सा है?
q_en: Which is the superlative form of 'bad'?
e_hi: 'worst' 'bad' का सर्वोच्च रूप है।
e_en: 'worst' is the superlative of 'bad'.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य तुलनात्मक विशेषण रखता है?
q_en: Which sentence contains a comparative adjective?
o_hi: The river is wider than the lake.
o_en: The river is wider than the lake.
e_hi: दूसरे वाक्य में 'wider' तुलनात्मक विशेषण है।
e_en: The second sentence contains the comparative adjective 'wider'.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्द जोड़ों में से कौन सा तुलनात्मक और सर्वोच्च रूप सही है?
q_en: Which of the following pairs correctly represents a comparative and its superlative?
e_hi: 'fast, faster, fastest' सही क्रम है।
e_en: 'fast, faster, fastest' is the correct sequence.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द एक विशेष संज्ञा (proper noun) है?
q_en: Which of the following is a proper noun?
e_hi: विशेष संज्ञा वह होती है जो किसी व्यक्ति, स्थान या वस्तु का विशिष्ट नाम हो। 'राहुल' एक व्यक्ति का नाम है।
e_en: A proper noun is a specific name of a person, place or thing. 'Rahul' is a person's name.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य एक जटिल वाक्य (complex sentence) है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is a complex sentence?
o_hi: वह आया क्योंकि बारिश हो रही थी।
सूरज चमक रहा है और पक्षी गा रहे हैं।
o_en: He came because it was raining.
The sun is shining and the birds are singing.
e_hi: जटिल वाक्य में एक मुख्य वाक्य और एक या अधिक उपवाक्य होते हैं। 'वह आया क्योंकि बारिश हो रही थी।' में कारण का उपवाक्य है।
e_en: A complex sentence contains a main clause and one or more subordinate clauses. 'He came because it was raining.' has a subordinate clause.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित क्रियाओं में से कौन सी एक स्थिर क्रिया (stative verb) है?
q_en: Which of the following verbs is a stative verb?
e_hi: 'है' एक स्थिर क्रिया है जो अवस्था को दर्शाती है।
e_en: 'to be' is a stative verb as it denotes a state.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से कौन सा विशेषण (adjective) है?
q_en: Which of the following words is an adjective?
e_hi: विशेषण वह शब्द है जो संज्ञा को वर्णित करता है। 'सुंदर' एक विशेषण है।
e_en: An adjective describes a noun. 'beautiful' is an adjective.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में से कौन सा सही ढंग से अर्धविराम (semicolon) का प्रयोग करता है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences uses a semicolon correctly?
o_hi: मैंने खाना खा लिया; और फिर सो गया।
वह अच्छा है; वह बुद्धिमान है।
वह स्कूल गया; क्योंकि वह थका हुआ था।
वह खुश है; वह उदास है।
o_en: I ate dinner; and then I slept.
He is good; he is intelligent.
He went to school; because he was tired.
He is happy; he is sad.
e_hi: अर्धविराम का प्रयोग स्वतंत्र वाक्यों को जोड़ने के लिये किया जाता है। 'वह अच्छा है; वह बुद्धिमान है।' सही है।
e_en: A semicolon joins independent clauses. 'He is good; he is intelligent.' is correct.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्यांश एक संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य (relative clause) है?
q_en: Which of the following clauses is a relative clause?
e_hi: संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य संज्ञा को संशोधित करता है, जैसे 'जो किताब मैंने पढ़ी'।
e_en: A relative clause modifies a noun, e.g., 'the book that I read'.

q_hi: वाक्य 'वह तेज़ दौड़ रहा है' में 'दौड़' किस प्रकार का शब्द है?
q_en: In the sentence 'He is running fast', what part of speech is 'running'?
e_hi: 'दौड़' यहाँ क्रिया के रूप में प्रयोग हुआ है।
e_en: 'running' is used as a verb here.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में से कौन सा S-V-O पैटर्न का अनुसरण करता है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences follows the S-V-O pattern?
e_hi: S-V-O: कर्ता-क्रिया-कर्म। 'वह किताब पढ़ता है।' इस पैटर्न में है।
e_en: S-V-O pattern is subject-verb-object. 'He reads a book.' follows it.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य में कौन सा काल (tense) है? 'वे तब से पढ़ रहे थे जब तक कि वह आया।'
q_en: Which tense is used in the sentence 'They had been studying since he arrived'?
e_hi: यह भूतपूर्व सतत काल है, जो 'had been studying' से स्पष्ट है।
e_en: It is the past perfect continuous tense, indicated by 'had been studying'.

q_hi: वाक्य को सही क्रिया से पूरा करें: 'She ___ to school every day.'
q_en: Complete the sentence with the correct verb form: 'She ___ to school every day.'
e_hi: 'She' एक तृतीय पुरुष एकवचन है, इसलिए सही क्रिया 'goes' है।
e_en: The subject 'She' is third person singular, so the verb must be 'goes'.

q_hi: सही सर्वनाम चुनें: 'It was ___ who called.'
q_en: Choose the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: 'It was ___ who called.'
e_hi: वाक्य में 'was' के बाद विषय पूरक के रूप में सर्वनाम का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'I' सही है।
e_en: In a subject complement after 'was', the pronoun must be in the nominative case, so 'I' is correct.

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: 'There ___ many people in the room.'
q_en: Choose the correct sentence: 'There ___ many people in the room.'
e_hi: 'many people' बहुवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया 'are' होनी चाहिए।
e_en: Because 'many people' is plural, the verb must be 'are'.

q_hi: खाली स्थान भरें: 'Although it was raining, they ___ to the festival.'
q_en: Fill in the blank: 'Although it was raining, they ___ to the festival.'
e_hi: सभी परिस्थितियों में भूतकाल का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए सही उत्तर 'went' है।
e_en: The past simple is used in this context, so the correct answer is 'went'.

q_hi: स्नान करना एक अच्छा व्यायाम है। इस वाक्य में कौन सा शब्द gerund है?
q_en: Identify the gerund in the sentence: 'Swimming is a good exercise.'
e_hi: वाक्य में 'स्नान करना' एक gerund है।
e_en: In the sentence, 'Swimming' is the gerund.

q_hi: यदि आप बर्फ को गर्म करें तो वह ___।
q_en: If you heat ice, it ___ .
e_hi: This is a zero conditional, used for general truths: when ice is heated, it always melts. The correct answer is 'melts'.
e_en: This is a zero conditional, used for general truths: when ice is heated, it always melts. The correct answer is 'melts'.

q_hi: यह किताब ___ है उस से।
q_en: This book is ___ than that one.
e_hi: तुलना के लिए comparative रूप चाहिए, इसलिए 'बेहतर' सही है।
e_en: Because a comparative form is required, 'better' is correct.

q_hi: वह आदमी, ___ नीली टोपी पहने हुए है, मेरा चाचा है।
q_en: The man, ___ is wearing a blue hat, is my uncle.
e_hi: यह वाक्य में relative pronoun 'who' का प्रयोग है।
e_en: The sentence requires the relative pronoun 'who'.

q_hi: ट्रेन पहुँचने तक, यात्रियों ने पहले ही ___ बोर्ड कर लिया था।
q_en: By the time the train arrived, the passengers ___ already boarded.
e_hi: वाक्य में past perfect tense है, इसलिए 'था' सही है।
e_en: The sentence requires the past perfect, so 'had' is correct.

q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य passive voice में है?
q_en: Which of the following sentences is in passive voice?
o_hi: पत्र उसके द्वारा लिखा गया था
o_en: The letter was written by her
The letter will be written by her
e_hi: Passive voice में विषय (पत्र) पर क्रिया का प्रभाव होता है, इसलिए दूसरा विकल्प सही है।
e_en: In passive voice, the action is performed on the subject, so the second option is correct.

q_hi: वह कौन था जिसने कॉल किया? 'It was ___ who called.'
q_en: It was ___ who called.
e_hi: यह वाक्य में subject pronoun 'I' का प्रयोग है।
e_en: The sentence requires the subject pronoun 'I'.

q_hi: आप स्टेशन पर ___ को देखा?
q_en: ___ did you see at the station?
e_hi: यह प्रश्न 'whom' का प्रयोग करता है, इसलिए दूसरा विकल्प सही है।
e_en: The question requires 'whom', so the second option is correct.

q_hi: आप परीक्षा पास नहीं करेंगे जब तक आप ___ इसे नहीं पढ़ते।
q_en: You will not pass the exam unless you ___ it.
e_hi: इस शर्त वाक्य में present simple का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'पढ़ो' सही है।
e_en: This conditional sentence uses present simple, so 'study' is correct.

q_hi: केक ___ शेफ द्वारा कल बनाया गया था।
q_en: The cake ___ by the chef yesterday.
e_hi: यह वाक्य past passive tense में है, इसलिए 'was baked' सही है।
e_en: The sentence is in past passive tense, so 'was baked' is correct.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में सही क्रिया चुनें: "Either the students or the teacher _____ ready for the exam."
q_en: Choose the correct verb in the following sentence: "Either the students or the teacher _____ ready for the exam."
o_hi: दोनों छात्र या शिक्षक तैयार हैं।
दोनों छात्र या शिक्षक तैयार है।
दोनों छात्र या शिक्षक तैयार हूँ।
दोनों छात्र या शिक्षक तैयार हो।
e_hi: ‘either…or’ के बाद क्रिया उस संज्ञा के साथ मेल खाती है जो उससे निकट है। यहाँ ‘teacher’ एकवचन है, इसलिए ‘is’ सही है।
e_en: In the correlative construction ‘either…or’, the verb agrees with the noun closer to it. Here ‘teacher’ is singular, so ‘is’ is correct.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्य में कौन सा शब्द सही है? "The man ___ you saw yesterday is my uncle."
q_en: Which word correctly completes the sentence: "The man ___ you saw yesterday is my uncle."
e_hi: यह वाक्य में ‘whom’ प्रयोग होता है क्योंकि यह क्रिया ‘saw’ का वस्तु है।
e_en: The pronoun ‘whom’ is used here because it is the object of the verb ‘saw’.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य समानांतर संरचना (parallel structure) का सही उपयोग करता है?
q_en: Which sentence has correct parallel structure?
o_hi: She likes to swim, playing tennis, and hiking.
She likes swimming, tennis, and hiking.
She likes to swim, to play tennis, and to hike.
She likes swimming, playing tennis, and to hike.
o_en: She likes to swim, playing tennis, and hiking.
She likes swimming, tennis, and hiking.
She likes to swim, to play tennis, and to hike.
She likes swimming, playing tennis, and to hike.
e_hi: तीसरा विकल्प सभी क्रियाओं को ‘to’ के साथ रखकर समानांतर बनाता है।
e_en: The third option keeps all verbs in the infinitive form, creating proper parallelism.

q_hi: वाक्य में सही शब्द चुनें: "There are _____ people in the room than last time."
q_en: Choose the correct word: "There are _____ people in the room than last time."
e_hi: ‘People’ गिनने योग्य है, इसलिए ‘fewer’ सही है।
e_en: ‘People’ is countable, so ‘fewer’ is correct.

q_hi: कौन सा वाक्य सही क्रिया काल (tense) संगति रखता है?
q_en: Which sentence maintains proper tense consistency?
o_hi: She will go to the market and buys fruits.
She went to the market and buys fruits.
She went to the market and bought fruits.
She goes to the market and bought fruits.
o_en: She will go to the market and buys fruits.
She went to the market and buys fruits.
She went to the market and bought fruits.
She goes to the market and bought fruits.
e_hi: सभी क्रियाएँ एक ही काल में हैं – भूतकाल, इसलिए तीसरा विकल्प सही है।
e_en: All verbs are in the same tense – past tense, so the third option is correct.

q_hi: निम्न वाक्यों में से कौन सा वाक्य पासिव (passive) वॉयस में सही है?
q_en: Which sentence is correctly written in passive voice?
o_hi: The cake was baked by Mary.
Baked was the cake by Mary.
o_en: The cake was baked by Mary.
Baked was the cake by Mary.
e_hi: सही पासिव वाक्य ‘was baked by’ के साथ है।
e_en: The correct passive construction uses ‘was baked by’.

q_hi: वाक्य में रिक्त स्थान पर सही शब्द चुनें: "Neither the manager nor the employees ____ aware of the new policy."
q_en: Choose the correct word to fill the blank: "Neither the manager nor the employees ____ aware of the new policy."
e_hi: विषय-क्रिया सामंजस्य में, निकटतम विषय "employees" बहुवचन है, अतः क्रिया भी बहुवचन "are" होनी चाहिए।
e_en: In subject‑verb agreement, the nearest subject "employees" is plural, so the verb must be plural "are".

q_hi: सही वाक्य चुनें: "They have been waiting for the train since 5pm."
q_en: Select the correct sentence: "They have been waiting for the train since 5pm."
o_hi: They have been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They had been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They will have been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They were waiting for the train since 5pm.
o_en: They have been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They had been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They will have been waiting for the train since 5pm.
They were waiting for the train since 5pm.
e_hi: वर्तमान पूर्ण निरन्तर काल (present perfect continuous) का प्रयोग यहाँ सही है क्योंकि कार्य 5 बजे से शुरू होकर अभी भी जारी है।
e_en: The present perfect continuous tense is appropriate because the action started at 5 pm and continues up to now.

q_hi: सही निष्क्रिय वाक्य चुनें: "The chef cooked the meal."
q_en: Choose the correct passive form of the sentence "The chef cooked the meal."
o_hi: The meal was cooked by the chef.
The meal is cooked by the chef.
The meal will be cooked by the chef.
The meal has cooked the chef.
o_en: The meal was cooked by the chef.
The meal is cooked by the chef.
The meal will be cooked by the chef.
The meal has cooked the chef.
e_hi: निष्क्रिय वाक्य में कर्म विषय बनता है और क्रिया भूतकाल में होती है: "The meal was cooked by the chef."
e_en: In passive voice, the object becomes the subject and the verb is in past tense: "The meal was cooked by the chef."

q_hi: सही सर्वनाम चुनें: "To ___ did you send the letter?"
q_en: Choose the correct pronoun: "To ___ did you send the letter?"
e_hi: यह वाक्य कर्म वाक्यांश है, अतः सर्वनाम "her" प्रयोग होता है।
e_en: The sentence is an object clause, so the objective pronoun "her" is used.

q_hi: सही पूर्वसर्ग चुनें: "He will arrive ___ 9 o'clock."
q_en: Choose the correct preposition: "He will arrive ___ 9 o'clock."
e_hi: समय के लिए "at" प्रयोग होता है: "at 9 o’clock"।
e_en: The preposition "at" is used with specific times: "at 9 o’clock."

q_hi: सही सम्बन्धवाचक सर्वनाम चुनें: "The man ____ lives next door is a doctor."
q_en: Choose the correct relative pronoun: "The man ____ lives next door is a doctor."
e_hi: व्यक्ति के लिए "who" सही है।
e_en: The pronoun "who" is appropriate for a person.

q_hi: सही शब्द चुनें: "You will not be able to attend ___ you finish the work."
q_en: Choose the correct word: "You will not be able to attend ___ you finish the work."
e_hi: शर्त के लिए "unless" का प्रयोग होता है, जिसका अर्थ "जब तक नहीं" है।
e_en: The conditional meaning "unless" (unless you finish) is required.

q_hi: सही शब्द चुनें: "The committee will decide ___ the proposal."
q_en: Choose the correct word: "The committee will decide ___ the proposal."
e_hi: संज्ञा पर निर्णय लेने के लिये "on" प्रयोग होता है: "decide on the proposal."
e_en: The preposition "on" is used with decisions about a noun: "decide on the proposal."

q_hi: वाक्य "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" में शब्द "quick" किस व्याकरणिक वर्ग का है?
q_en: In the sentence "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", what part of speech is the word "quick"?
e_hi: यहाँ "quick" एक विशेषण है जो संज्ञा "fox" को संशोधित करता है।
e_en: Here, "quick" is an adjective that modifies the noun "fox".

q_hi: वाक्य "After finishing the work, the students went home" में विषय कौन सा है?
q_en: In the sentence "After finishing the work, the students went home", who is the subject?
o_hi: After finishing the work, the students
o_en: After finishing the work, the students
e_hi: वाक्य का विषय "the students" है।
e_en: The subject of the sentence is "the students".

q_hi: वाक्य "The cat is on the mat" में कौन सा शब्द पूर्वसर्ग है?
